messages.content:
<document id=DOC_release_note>
Release 4.2 closes three reported defects. The importer no longer
drops a trailing column when a file ends without a newline. The
scheduler retries a failed job twice before reporting it. The audit
log records the account that performed a deletion.
</document>

response.text:
Version 4.2 resolves three issues:  
- The importer now handles files without a final newline correctly.  
- The scheduler retries failed jobs two additional times before reporting failure.  
- The audit log now records which account performed deletions.
